summary: Previously recorded Perplexity startup terms: $5,000 in API credits plus 3 months of Enterprise Pro for up to 50 seats; raised up to $20M in equity funding, less than 5 years old, associated with an approved Startup Partner, and not an existing Enterprise Pro customer. As of 2026-10-13, the recorded startup URL redirects to the generic /hub page. Current enrollment and these grant terms need provider/partner confirmation. Historical six-month launch copy is not current verification; the three-month figure came from the 2026-09-27 official-page snapshot.
claim_steps: The recorded https://www.perplexity.ai/startups/ enrollment URL redirects to /hub as of 2026-10-13; it is not a confirmed current application path.
Ask an approved Startup Partner or Perplexity support for the current enrollment URL and written grant terms before relying on the listed benefits.
Confirm the previously recorded eligibility rules: ≤$20M equity funding, <5 years old, approved Startup Partner association, and no existing Enterprise Pro subscription.

social_proof.text: Eligible startups get 3 months of free Perplexity Enterprise Pro for up to 50 seats, plus $5k in API credits to supercharge their growth.
